concerns.text: FR-007 specifies hypothesis testing via a 95 % bootstrap confidence interval on the scaling factor *s*, while the acceptance scenario in User Story 2 demands a p‑value test (p < 0.05). The two methods are not equivalent and the spec does not guarantee the required p‑value output, creating a contradictory requirement.
